items.title: my digital footprint is f*cked
items.summary:
my digital footprint is f*cked

i got early access to GPT-6 Cyber ​​and connected it to Grok Bot.

then i gave it my phone number, old usernames, email addresses, and one instruction:

“find every version of me that’s still out there.”

i expected abandoned accounts.

it found an address i moved out of years ago. a profile under a username i’d forgotten. my number attached to a company i no longer work for.

then Grok started connecting the records.

different websites. different names. the same person.

me.

Grok handled the search.
Cyber ​​investigated the weak points.
Grok used the openings to reach the databases and remove the matching records.

i was watching the terminal on my phone when the first profile disappeared.

refreshed the page.

gone.

another record. another lookup. another result that no longer focused on me.

the part that got me wasn’t the code flying across the screen.

it was searching my own number afterward and getting nothing useful back.

i’d spent years blocking individual spam callers while the same information kept getting passed around.

now the phone was quiet.

no “quick question.”
no recruiter asking about a job from three years ago.
no stranger who somehow already knew my name.

i kept checking whether my phone was on silent.

it wasn't.

for once, searching for me didn’t hand someone a map of my life.

the setup, prompts, and practical privacy-cleanup workflow are below ↓

items.title: Falling snow, stolen kisses, and a love that never stands still.
items.summary:
Falling snow, stolen kisses, and a love that never stands still.

Created with GPT Image 2.6 + Seedance 2.5 on @openart_ai 

Prompt:

AUDIO RULE: Natural sound only. No music, no score, no voiceover, no dialogue. Ambient winter city sound and foley only.

MOTION RULE: Continuous movement in every shot. The couple never stop, freeze or hold a pose, and the camera is always moving. Every romantic moment happens while they walk, spin or run.

STYLE: Hand-painted illustrated look, matching the location reference: soft painterly brush texture, warm amber lamplight against cool lavender-gray snow haze. Same color grade in every shot.

CHARACTER LOCK: <<<image_1>>>  is a single character sheet showing two people. The TOP ROW is the woman and the BOTTOM ROW is the man. Match both exactly in every shot.
The woman (top row): messy curly dark-brown hair in a loose updo with loose strands, freckles, small gold hoop earrings. Long dark brown textured wool coat, white collared shirt, charcoal wide-leg trousers, black leather belt, black lace-up boots. She also wears a burgundy fringed wool scarf, as in the location image. She carries a paper cup of tea with the tea-bag tag hanging out.
The man (bottom row): tall, tousled wavy dark-brown hair, freckles. Long brown herringbone tweed coat, olive-green fringed scarf, cream cable-knit sweater, dark brown trousers, dark leather boots.
SCARF LOCK: His olive scarf stays on his neck and her burgundy scarf stays on hers in every shot. Scarves never move between people.
Faces, hair, outfits, heights and proportions never change between shots. They look at each other with deep affection and never look at the camera.

LOCATION: <<<image_2>>> , snowy Upper West Side at dusk. Gas-style street lamps, snow-covered trees, black iron fences, brownstones with warm lit windows and snowy stoops, a street sign reading "W 73 St / Broadway", a yellow taxi, the Empire State Building glowing in the haze. Soft snow falls throughout.

SHOT 1 (0:00-0:03)
Camera: Wide tracking shot gliding backward ahead of them down the snowy sidewalk, lamps streaking past.
Action: They walk toward us, his arm around her shoulders, her tea steaming. She leans her head against him while they walk, and he kisses the top of her head without breaking stride. Snow swirls through the lamplight and a yellow taxi slides by behind them.
Sound: Crunching, slushy footsteps, a muffled tire hiss, a soft contented sigh, gentle wind.

HARD CUT

SHOT 2 (0:03-0:06)
Camera: Medium shot, smooth handheld tracking sideways at walking pace, shallow depth of field.
Action: Still walking, he opens the front of his coat and pulls her in against his side, wrapping the coat around her shoulder. His olive scarf stays on his neck and her burgundy scarf stays on hers. She laughs, looks up at him, and catches a snowflake on her tongue. He grins and tucks a loose curl behind her ear as they keep moving.
Sound: Her bright laugh, wool rustling, quick footsteps, snow hush.

HARD CUT

SHOT 3 (0:06-0:09)
Camera: Low tracking shot at hip height, following their hands and the cup as they move, warm window lights streaming past.
Action: They swing their linked hands as they walk. She lifts the steaming cup to his lips and he sips, smiling at her. Snowflakes melt on his knuckles and her burgundy scarf fringe while the tea-bag tag sways.
Sound: Cup crinkle, a quiet sip, playful breath, soft footsteps, a car passing.

HARD CUT

SHOT 4 (0:09-0:12)
Camera: Fast but smooth circling orbit around them, snow flying through the foreground.
Action: He lifts her hand and spins her under his arm. Her coat flares and her curls swing as she twirls, laughing. She spins back into him and they keep moving in a flowing walking waltz down the sidewalk, foreheads close, eyes locked.
Sound: Coat swish, her delighted laugh, quick light footsteps in snow, a distant bell.

HARD CUT

SHOT 5 (0:12-0:15)
Camera: Sweeping crane move that begins close and rises into a wide pull-back, following them up the avenue with the Empire State Building glowing in the haze.
Action: Hand in hand, they run a few joyful steps through the falling snow, then he pulls her in and they kiss mid-stride, still moving, her scarf fringe flying. They keep walking away up the avenue, arms around each other, leaving two sets of footprints as the flakes thicken.
Sound: Quick crunching footsteps, a happy laugh, coat rustle, fading into the hush of falling snow.

AVOID: music, dialogue, text overlays, still poses, freeze frames, camera looks, face or hairstyle drift, swapping the two characters' outfits, scarves moving between people, any change to coats, scarves, earrings or boots between shots, photorealistic style.

items.title: AI videos are getting too good
items.summary:
AI videos are getting too good

we’re cooked.

here's the full workflow with prompts, step-by-step:

1. find a real UGC video on TikTok as a reference for style, emotions, and movement (style reference not a copycat video with different face)

2. create your reference image, use Nano Banana Pro instead of GPT-image 2, nano was trained on older phones so it's not overpolished

3. get a clear image of the product you want to advertise

4. upload everything you have to GPT with prompt template (below)  to generate prompt

5. upload all 3 references to Seedance 2.5 and generate using references mode, 720p is enough, and your preferred aspect ratio and duration

6. watch the result with sound and always check the eyes, skin, voice, and background

7. try the same setup in Wan 3.0 for a 2x cheaper alternative

===

prompt template:

You are an expert at writing prompts for Seedance 2.5 (reference mode) that produce realistic, TikTok-style UGC videos. Nothing about the result should look or sound like AI.

I'm uploading:
- @Image1 – the exact first frame of the video (the person, outfit, setting, lighting and framing)
- @Video1 – a real TikTok video. Copy the person's physical performance, energy, movement and way of talking from it
- @Image2 – the product

Study all three files carefully. Then write one prompt in plain English, lowercase, with these 7 numbered sections and nothing else:

1. format & visual references
The length of the video, "natural tiktok ugc style", @Image1 as the exact first frame and visual reference for the person, outfit, setting, lighting and framing, @Video1 as the reference for physical performance, voice and accent.

2. body language & movement
Match the posture, hand gestures, facial movements and body language from @Video1. Describe 1–2 specific movements you can actually see in @Video1 (for example, how she sits down, leans in or moves her hands while she talks).

3. dialogue
"she says exactly what is written between the brackets: [ ... ]". Write the script in the brackets. It should sound like a real person talking to a friend, not like an ad: short sentences, small reactions, no marketing words. It must fit the video length when spoken at a natural pace.

4. voice, emotions & reactions
How she speaks (pace, energy, tone) and how her emotions change line by line. Quote specific lines from the script and describe the reaction on each one (a quick laugh, disbelief, getting excited, turning mock-serious, ending warmly). Ask for natural changes in pitch, emphasis and speed, with tiny pauses that fit the reactions.

5. product interaction
Exactly when and how @Image2 comes into the video (where she takes it from, on which line it appears), how she shows it to the camera with the label visible, and what her other hand does at the same time.

6. timing & realism
Fit the full performance within the video length. Realistic skin texture, natural blinking, accurate lip sync and room sound that fits the setting (echo in a bathroom, quiet hum in a bedroom, wind and traffic outside).

7. camera & restrictions
One continuous shot, the same camera as in @Image1 (handheld or stationary), and a list of what the video must NOT have: no shouting, no music, no cuts, no zooms, no captions, no tiktok logo, no extra spoken words.

Rules:
- Use @Image1, @Video1 and @Image2 exactly like that, so Seedance knows which file is which.
- Describe only what you can see in the files. Don't invent a new room, outfit or person.
- Keep every section short and concrete. No general phrases like "high quality" or "cinematic".
- Give me only the finished prompt, ready to paste.

MY VIDEO
- Product: [product name + what it does]
- Video length: [e.g. 15–20 seconds]
- Accent: [e.g. american]
- What she should say / the idea: [e.g. she just spent the last of her money on this cream and she's excited but feels a bit guilty]

“Ultra-realistic iPhone selfie portrait of a beautiful 22-year-old woman with soft European facial features, fair skin, subtle natural freckles, warm brown almond-shaped eyes, long lashes, a small straight nose, naturally full glossy pink lips, and softly defined cheekbones. Shoulder-length layered champagne-blonde hair with darker roots, voluminous curtain bangs, and slightly messy natural waves. Wearing a fitted dark charcoal long-sleeve top, small silver hoop earrings, and a beaded necklace with a round spiral pendant. Relaxed neutral expression, subtle closed-mouth smile, direct eye contact. Standing in a dim bedroom with beige walls, dark furniture, and hanging ivy in the corner. Soft frontal window light illuminating her face, dark underexposed background. Authentic casual iPhone photography, realistic skin texture, natural imperfections, no beauty filters, no AI look, vertical 3:4 composition.”

2. generate a character sheet of your AI avatar with this prompt:

“Character turnaround sheet of the person from the reference photo, six views: full body front, side and back + super close-up front, side and back. Strictly keep 100% of face, hair, body, clothing and all details from the reference.
Clean gray background, consistent and natural lighting.”

3. download a viral tiktok or reel where the creator is yapping about something

4. cut a 10s clip from the video

5. use the video + character sheet as references in wan 3.0 prime with this prompt:

“Replace the girl in {video} with the girl in {character sheet}.
Keep the same movements, camera quality, voice tone, background sounds, and hand gestures.
Remove ALL on-screen text. NO subtitles, NO captions, NO text overlays at any point.
Replace the original speech with this EXACT script, word for word. Pronounce every word clearly with natural pacing and accurate lip sync. Do not skip, change, rush, or cut off any words. Make sure the entire script is spoken.

{script}”

items.title: AI Has Entered the Boardroom. Who’s Overseeing It? | Stanford Graduate School of Business
items.summary:
In the survey, 75% of directors said they used AI for research and market analysis, 55% for board prep and material summarization. Other common uses included strategic question generation and competitive benchmarking. Matthys says that board members would ideally like to use AI “to track and summarize board packages and more quickly understand year-to-year trends by using LLM tools rather than reading 80- to 100-page reports.” [...] The sooner the better, the researchers suggest. “Moving too slowly with AI governance means you may miss out on opportunities,” Saripalli says. “The board has fiduciary responsibility for anything that has impact at the product or service level.”

“The risk of not moving is as serious as the risk of AI systems running amok,” Matthys adds, noting how past technological shifts have left unprepared companies behind. “If you don’t keep up, there’s a risk that 20 years from now you won’t exist.” [...] ## In Brief

 A new survey finds that corporate boards are not keeping up with AI governance.
 Directors report that they are discussing and using AI, yet their boards lack a systematic approach to oversight.
 Companies that wait to define AI strategy and audit their AI use risk being left behind.

“We’re trying to change the wheels on the bus while driving it at 100 miles an hour downhill.”

Cụ thể hóa định hướng này, Quyết định số 21/2026/QĐ-TTg ngày 30/4/2026 của Thủ tướng Chính phủ ban hành Danh mục công nghệ chiến lược và Danh mục sản phẩm công nghệ chiến lược, xác định 10 nhóm công nghệ và 30 sản phẩm công nghệ chiến lược quốc gia. Các nhóm công nghệ được ưu tiên bao gồm công nghệ số, trí tuệ nhn tạo, mạng di động thế hệ sau, robot và tự động hóa, công nghệ sinh học và y sinh tiên tiến, năng lượng và vật liệu tiên tiến, chip bán dẫn, an ninh mạng và lượng tử, công nghệ biển, [...] Đồng hành cùng Giải thưởng Khoa học công nghệ Quả Cầu Vàng từ năm 2011, Tn Hiệp Phát là một trong những doanh nghiệp có hành trình gắn bó lu dài với hoạt động phát hiện, tôn vinh và khích lệ tài năng trẻ khoa học công nghệ Việt Nam.

Tn Hiệp Phát tổ chức nhiều chương trình thăm quan hệ thống công nghệ sản xuất tại nhà máy, kết nối nghiên cứu khoa học và thực tiễn doanh nghiệp. Ảnh: L. Khoa [...] Tn Hiệp Phát đồng hành, tiếp sức khát vọng sáng tạo của tài năng trẻ khoa học công nghệ Việt Nam

Phát hiện và tôn vinh tài năng chỉ là bước khởi đầu. Để những tài năng trẻ tiếp tục phát triển và đóng góp cho đất nước, cần có môi trường nghiên cứu thuận lợi, nguồn lực hỗ trợ và đặc biệt là cơ hội đưa các ý tưởng khoa học đến gần hơn với thực tiễn.

items.summary:
this is f*cking insane. andrej karpathy: "the biggest regret of every engineer in my field right now is every AI conversation they never saved, and in 10 years the ones who started saving in 2024 will be running circles around the rest of us"

andrej karpathy, co-founder of openai, pulled 16M views on one idea: stop using AI to write code, use it to build a second brain that remembers every article, pdf, transcript and conversation you ever fed it

you point claude code at a folder, drop anything into it, and claude reads it, cross-links it with everything already there, and writes it into a living wiki. your knowledge finally compounds instead of leaking out of your head every friday

the stack:

→ brew install obsidian, mkdir ~/vault, cd ~/vault
→ run claude in that folder and type "init a knowledge vault with CLAUDE.md as the rules, /raw for sources, /wiki for your pages"
→ drop any file into /raw (youtube transcript, meeting notes, 400-page pdf, screenshot of a tweet) and type "ingest"
→ claude writes a wiki page, links it to 5 existing ones automatically, updates CLAUDE.md with any new pattern it noticed about how you think
→ never open a blank claude chat again. every question goes through the vault, every answer cites your own sources with dates and links

5 minutes to set up. compounding knowledge from that evening forward

the ugly part most will scroll past: in 10 years the engineers who started this in 2024 will remember every book, every podcast, every meeting with receipts. you will remember none of them. karpathy already picked which side he is on and you are still not on his

items.title: Artificial intelligence is desperately seeking its narrative
items.summary:
The first narrative presents AI as a civilisational gamble: it could usher in unprecedented abundance and scientific progress, but also trigger catastrophes or escape human control.

In September 2024, OpenAI CEO Sam Altman envisioned AI accelerating scientific discovery, solving complex problems and making capabilities once reserved for specialists widely accessible. [...] Researcher Yann Le Cun, the former head of research at Meta, advocates a rationalist counter-narrative. In a February 2024 interview with Time magazine, he stressed that large language models have neither a robust understanding of the physical world nor genuine reasoning and planning abilities comparable to those of humans. He considers the scenario in which an artificial intelligence takes control of the world to be implausible. He also supports greater openness in AI models. In his view, just [...] How did a technology promising unprecedented prosperity come to generate such hostility? Part of the answer lies in AI’s real or anticipated effects on society. Another lies in the narratives surrounding it.

Four broad narratives currently shape the discourse on artificial intelligence. They are neither mutually exclusive nor entirely coherent: the same company or executive may embrace several, sometimes contradictory, visions.

## Narrative No. 1: ‘AI will save us… if it does not destroy us’

items.summary:
Dexterity: Our robots can perform significantly more tasks with greater performance and dexterity — from using everyday tools to handling delicate, flexible objects.

This could enable robots to take on monotonous work, to enable technicians to focus on complex build tasks. [...] Robots struggle to adapt to new unpredictable environments, our Gemini Robotics models give Apollo the ability to think, reason over multiple steps, and take action adapting to changes. In this proof-of-concept, Apollo 2 autonomously performs automotive kitting: the repetitive, physically taxing task of sorting individual parts from bulk bins into organized trays in the exact order needed for each vehicle on the line. Offloading this monotonous prep work helps keep the assembly line moving, [...] With Gemini Robotics 2.5, we expanded the model capabilities in task breadth, performance, and complexity. We evaluated the model across 200 distinct tasks — such as serving food with tongs, tying a bow on a gift box, and pipetting a liquid. These tasks represent a step toward human-level dexterity by combining a number of skills, including advanced tool use, complex manipulation of deformables, and handling delicate objects with finesse.

items.title: Industrial automation startup Path Robotics raises $300M in funding - SiliconANGLE
items.summary: Path Robotics originally developed Obsidian for large robotic workstations called welding cells. In April, it introduced a four-legged robot called Rove that uses the model to automate shipbuilding tasks. The company says that its software can also be used to make parts for vehicles, power generators, utility poles and other heavy equipment. [...] Path Robotics has developed an AI model that addresses those challenges. Obsidian, as it’s called, is specifically designed to power industrial robots equipped with welding torches. The company says that the model can observe how metal parts change shape during the welding process and adjust its workflow accordingly. Furthermore, it automatically accounts for unexpected part variations. [...] Obsidian monitors the welding workflow using four lasers attached to the torch that it controls. The emitters illuminate the parts being welded together and the reflected light is captured by a pair of cameras. According to Path Robotics, Obsidian collects data not only during the welding process but also before and after each run.

Apptronik has thus far been DeepMind's most heavily publicized humanoid manufacturer, though the team has also partnered with Agile Robotics and Boston Dynamics (the latter's most prominent team up has arrived in the form of Spot robot-based industrial inspection).

Franka's FR3 Duo has also featured heavily in DeepMind Robotics' work. Along with Apollo 2, the bimanual system executed on the 200 tasks highlighted in this morning's announcement.

items.title: Aguascalientes students take top robotics prizes
items.summary:
The Aguascalientes team, nicknamed Lanceros Overclock, won the high school division (ages 14 to 20) of Robo Shuttle at ROBOchæmpions, held Saturday and Sunday in the city of Lörrach. 

The competition required the budding scientists to work in teams of two or four to build and program autonomous robots that would perform predetermined tasks. (Phaenovum) [...] Overall, 16 students from Aguascalientes competed, but the names of the winners were not included in official results.

According to organizer Phaenovum — a student research center in Lörrach, Germany — the inaugural competition hosted teams from Mexico and Egypt in addition to regional competitors. It succeeded RoboRAVE Germany, a previous local version of RoboRAVE.

The organizer published results in five categories spanning races, robot duels, transport tasks and autonomous firefighting. [...] One challenge required robots to extinguish a candle flame autonomously.

Teams prepared and tested their robots Saturday before Sunday’s judging, awards ceremony and public demonstrations.
